How it works

Your year. One clear view.

See the low, test a purchase, and know what to hold back.

$52,400 in starting cash becomes $500 safely available after upcoming obligations and a $6,000 minimum buffer are protected.

A $15,000 October purchase is tested against the projected $6,500 March low—not just today’s balance.
